products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory founded in 2020 and operating as the applied research arm of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). The institute describes its mission as making advanced AI accessible and available globally, and its public-facing work centers on the Falcon family of large language models, released under the Apache 2.0 license and hosted in the UAE.

The Falcon model family spans a range of architectures and scales. Falcon 180B was trained on 180 billion parameters and 3.5 trillion tokens, while Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, was described as the first open-source LLM of its kind released with weights for both research and commercial use. Newer additions include Falcon-H1, a hybrid model combining Transformer and Mamba architecture that the institute says outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and Falcon H1R 7B, a 7 billion parameter model focused on reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic, and instruction-following. The family also includes Falcon 2 11B, which the institute says outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B model as verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard, Falcon Mamba 7B described as the first open-source State Space Language Model, Falcon Arabic targeting Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects, and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language capabilities. TII has also launched the non-profit Falcon Foundation to support the open-source generative AI ecosystem, and a related entity, AI71, was launched by ATRC and VentureOne to commercialize Falcon applications.
